# DeepResValue

> DeepResValue (深度研值) — AI Research Assistant Agent SaaS for all academic disciplines. 100+ professional research skills, four compute kernels (Python, R, MATLAB/Octave, SPICE-ngspice), Word + LaTeX typesetting, MCP connectors, BYOK model support. Single Chinese sentence drives the full research workflow with full traceability. "让科研回归本质，让工具服务于思想，让创造不被重复所困"

## Notes

- AI research assistant platform for researchers, graduate students, and faculty
- Supports all academic disciplines with emphasis on humanities & social sciences
- 3,000+ users from 985/211 universities; thousands of validated projects
- Product-Market Fit achieved; in formal launch and growth phase
- Official website: https://deepresvalue.top/
